en.greeting: Hi! Today you listen to longer, real speech: messages from colleagues, a lecturer's announcement, a hobby, the news and podcasts. You'll find the main point and take quick notes. Play each sound as many times as you like.

steps.title: From key words to the main point
steps.text: You already listen for key words: a number, a time, a place. Now the speech is longer, so you also need the main point.
steps.body: The **main point** is the most important idea, not every detail. While you listen, ask three questions: **Who is talking, and to whom?** **What is the topic?** **What is the main message?** (what changes, what's new, what people have to do, or why). The main point is often in the **first one or two sentences**, and speakers often repeat it at the end. Days, rooms and examples are usually **details**. Don't translate every word: follow the idea.

steps.title: Signposts show the way
steps.text: Speakers use small words that tell you what's coming next. Tap each tile to hear it.
steps.body: **Signposts** are like the signs on a toll road. **First… Then… Finally…** give the order. **The main reason is…** and **The most important thing is…** mean the main point is coming: listen carefully! After **However** or **but**, the direction changes: the new or true information comes **after** it. **Instead** brings the new plan. **So** gives the result. **For example** gives a detail. Wait for the end of the sentence before you decide.

pairs.id: Hal yang paling penting… → poin utama!

steps.title: Listen: a message at work
steps.text: Dimas leaves a voice message for his team. What changes?

question.listen: Hi everyone, it's Dimas. A quick update about our team meeting. From next week, we're going to meet on Tuesday mornings, not Mondays. The main reason is that many of you visit clients on Mondays. The room and the time are the same: room 4, at nine o'clock.
question.prompt: Listen to Dimas's message. What is the main point?
options: The team meeting is moving from Monday to Tuesday.
The team meeting is moving to a new room.
Many people are going to visit clients on Tuesday.
question.explanation: The main point is the change: **Tuesday mornings, not Mondays**. Visiting clients on **Mondays** is the reason, and the room and the time are the same, so they're only details.

steps.title: Listen: a hobby
steps.text: Sari talks about her hobby. Listen for the signposts **However** and **The main reason is**.

question.listen: I started running two years ago. At first, I ran to lose weight. However, that isn't the reason now. The main reason is my running group. Every Sunday morning we run together in Senayan, and then we have breakfast. I've made a lot of good friends there.
question.prompt: Listen to Sari. What is the main reason she runs now?
options: She wants to lose weight.
She wants to run in a big race.
She enjoys running with her group.
question.explanation: Losing weight was the old reason: **However, that isn't the reason now.** Then the signpost **The main reason is** gives the answer: her running group and her new friends there. Nobody talks about a race.

steps.title: News reports and podcasts
steps.text: News and podcasts have a clear shape, so you know where to listen.
steps.body: **News:** the **first sentence** gives the main news (what happened + where). Then come the details (when, how many, how much), and at the end what's **going to** happen or advice (*Drivers should…*). New news often uses the present perfect: *has started*, *have left*. **Podcasts** (audio shows, often one person talking): first the podcast's name and the **host** (pembawa acara), then the topic: *Today's topic is…* or *In this episode, I'm going to talk about…*. Careful: the podcast's name is not today's topic!

pairs.en: Drivers should avoid the main road.

steps.title: Listen: the local news
steps.text: A short news report from Bandung. Remember: the first sentence gives the main news.

question.listen: Here is the local news. A new bus line has started in Bandung today. The buses go from the train station to the airport every twenty minutes, and a ticket costs five thousand rupiah. The city is going to add two more lines next year.
question.prompt: Listen to the news report. What is the main news?
options: Bandung is going to build a new airport.
A new bus line has started in Bandung.
The train station in Bandung has a new ticket price.
question.explanation: The first sentence gives the main news: **A new bus line has started in Bandung today.** The airport and the train station are where the buses go, and five thousand rupiah is the bus ticket: details. Nobody says a new airport.

steps.title: Listen: a podcast
steps.text: The start of a podcast. Wait for the words that give the topic of **this** episode.

question.listen: Hello and welcome to Work Talk, the podcast for young workers in Indonesia. I'm Rina. In this episode, I'm going to talk about working from home. First, I'll explain how to plan your day. Then I'll give you three tips to stop checking your phone all the time.
question.prompt: Listen to the podcast. What is the topic of this episode?
options: Young workers in Indonesia
Finding your first job
Working from home
question.explanation: **In this episode, I'm going to talk about** working from home: that's the topic. *The podcast for young workers in Indonesia* describes the whole podcast, not this episode. Planning your day and the phone tips are points inside the topic.

steps.title: Notes, not sentences
steps.text: Last skill: writing down what you hear, fast.
steps.body: You can't write every word, so write **key words**: **who, what, when** (day, date, time), **where** (place, room) and **numbers**. Write numbers as digits and use short forms: *Mon 20, 9:30*. Symbols help: **→** = so, **+** = and. Notes can be in English, Indonesian or a mix. After a change (*not Monday*, *However*, *Instead*), write only the **new** information. Traps: thir**TEEN** vs **THIR**ty; *half past one* = **1:30**, but *setengah satu* = 12:30!

pairs.id: siapa, apa, kapan, di mana, angka
hari Selasa, bukan Senin → tulis: Tue

steps.title: Listen and take notes
steps.text: A lecturer makes an announcement. Imagine you're writing notes: day, date, time, room, what to bring.

question.listen: Good morning, everyone. Before we start, an important change. The test is not on Thursday the fifteenth any more. It's on Friday the sixteenth, at half past two, in room B twelve. Please bring a pen and your student card.
question.prompt: Listen to the lecturer. Which notes are correct?
options: Test: Thu 15 · 2:30 · room B12 · pen + student card
Test: Fri 16 · 2:30 · room B12 · pen + student card
Test: Fri 16 · 1:30 · room B12 · pen + student card
question.explanation: Thursday the fifteenth is the old day (**not on Thursday… any more**): write the new one, **Fri 16**. **Half past two** = 2:30 (setengah tiga). 1:30 is the Indonesian trap: *setengah dua* is 1:30, but *half past two* is 2:30.

steps.title: Quick review
steps.text: Flip each card. Try to say the English before you look.

flashcards.front: Di episode ini, aku akan membahas…
flashcards.back: In this episode, I'm going to talk about…

steps.title: Cheat sheet
steps.text: Main points, signposts, news, podcasts and notes on one page.

artifact.title: Cheat sheet · Listening for main points
artifact.intro: What you hear, what it tells you, and what to write down.
rows: The main reason is… / The most important thing is…
the main point is coming: listen!
follow the order of the points
the new or true information comes after it
write the new plan, not the old one
the result or what to do
a detail, not the main point
Here is the news. … has opened / has started
Berikut beritanya. … sudah dibuka / sudah mulai
the first sentence = the main news
Today's topic is… / In this episode, …
Topik hari ini… / Di episode ini…
tips: Ask: who is talking, what is the topic, what is the main message? The main point is often in the first sentences.
Notes = key words: who, what, when, where, numbers. Digits, short forms, → for so, + for and.
Wait for the end of the sentence: after **however**, **instead** or **not**, the old information isn't true any more.

examples.en: The main reason is the price.
The office usually closes at five. However, today it closes at three.
examples.id: Kantor biasanya tutup jam lima. Namun, hari ini tutup jam tiga.

examples.en: Here is the news. A new hospital has opened in Medan.
examples.id: Berikut beritanya. Sebuah rumah sakit baru sudah dibuka di Medan.

examples.en: In this episode, I'm going to talk about learning English with films.
examples.id: Di episode ini, aku akan membahas belajar bahasa Inggris lewat film.

steps.title: Listen more
steps.text: Two B1 listening lessons with audio, transcripts and exercises: a lecture introduction and an interview.

id.greeting: Hai! Hari ini kamu mendengarkan ucapan nyata yang lebih panjang: pesan dari rekan kerja, pengumuman dosen, cerita tentang hobi, berita dan podcast. Kamu akan menangkap poin utamanya dan mencatat dengan cepat. Putar setiap suara sesering yang kamu mau.

steps.title: Dari kata kunci ke poin utama
steps.text: Kamu sudah bisa mendengarkan kata kunci: angka, jam, tempat. Sekarang ucapannya lebih panjang, jadi kamu juga perlu poin utamanya.
steps.body: **Poin utama** (main point) adalah ide yang paling penting, bukan setiap detail. Sambil mendengarkan, tanyakan tiga hal: **Siapa yang bicara, dan kepada siapa?** **Topiknya apa?** **Pesan utamanya apa?** (apa yang berubah, apa yang baru, apa yang harus dilakukan, atau kenapa). Poin utama sering ada di **satu-dua kalimat pertama**, dan pembicara sering mengulangnya di akhir. Hari, ruangan dan contoh biasanya hanya **detail**. Jangan terjemahkan setiap kata: ikuti idenya.

steps.title: Signpost: penunjuk arah
steps.text: Pembicara memakai kata-kata kecil yang memberitahu apa yang akan datang. Ketuk tiap kartu untuk mendengarnya.
steps.body: **Signpost** (kata penunjuk) seperti papan petunjuk di jalan tol. **First… Then… Finally…** memberi urutan. **The main reason is…** dan **The most important thing is…** berarti poin utama akan datang: dengarkan baik-baik! Setelah **However** (namun) atau **but**, arahnya berubah: info yang baru atau yang benar datang **setelahnya**. **Instead** (sebagai gantinya) membawa rencana baru. **So** (jadi) memberi hasilnya. **For example** (misalnya) memberi detail. Tunggu sampai kalimatnya selesai sebelum memutuskan.

pairs.id: Hal yang paling penting… → poin utama!

steps.title: Dengarkan: pesan di kantor
steps.text: Dimas meninggalkan pesan suara untuk timnya. Apa yang berubah?

question.listen: Hi everyone, it's Dimas. A quick update about our team meeting. From next week, we're going to meet on Tuesday mornings, not Mondays. The main reason is that many of you visit clients on Mondays. The room and the time are the same: room 4, at nine o'clock.
question.prompt: Dengarkan pesan Dimas. Apa poin utamanya?
options: The team meeting is moving from Monday to Tuesday.
The team meeting is moving to a new room.
Many people are going to visit clients on Tuesday.
question.explanation: Poin utamanya adalah perubahannya: **Tuesday mornings, not Mondays** (Selasa pagi, bukan Senin). Mengunjungi klien di hari **Senin** adalah alasannya, dan ruangan serta jamnya tetap sama, jadi itu hanya detail.
displayOptions: Rapat tim dipindahkan dari Senin ke Selasa.
Rapat tim dipindahkan ke ruangan baru.
Banyak orang akan mengunjungi klien hari Selasa.

steps.title: Dengarkan: sebuah hobi
steps.text: Sari bercerita tentang hobinya. Dengarkan signpost **However** dan **The main reason is**.

question.listen: I started running two years ago. At first, I ran to lose weight. However, that isn't the reason now. The main reason is my running group. Every Sunday morning we run together in Senayan, and then we have breakfast. I've made a lot of good friends there.
question.prompt: Dengarkan Sari. Apa alasan utama dia berlari sekarang?
options: She wants to lose weight.
She wants to run in a big race.
She enjoys running with her group.
question.explanation: Menurunkan berat badan adalah alasan yang lama: **However, that isn't the reason now** (Namun, sekarang bukan itu alasannya). Lalu signpost **The main reason is** memberi jawabannya: kelompok larinya dan teman-teman barunya di sana. Tidak ada yang membahas lomba.
displayOptions: Dia ingin ikut lomba lari besar.

steps.title: Berita dan podcast
steps.text: Berita dan podcast punya bentuk yang jelas, jadi kamu tahu di mana harus mendengarkan.
steps.body: **Berita:** **kalimat pertama** memberi berita utamanya (apa yang terjadi + di mana). Lalu rinciannya (kapan, berapa banyak, berapa harganya), dan di akhir apa yang **akan** terjadi (*going to*) atau saran (*Drivers should…*). Kabar baru sering memakai present perfect: *has started*, *have left*. **Podcast** (siaran audio, sering satu orang bicara): pertama nama podcast dan **host**-nya (pembawa acara), lalu topiknya: *Today's topic is…* atau *In this episode, I'm going to talk about…*. Hati-hati: nama podcast bukan topik hari ini!

pairs.en: Drivers should avoid the main road.

steps.title: Dengarkan: berita lokal
steps.text: Berita singkat dari Bandung. Ingat: kalimat pertama memberi berita utamanya.

question.listen: Here is the local news. A new bus line has started in Bandung today. The buses go from the train station to the airport every twenty minutes, and a ticket costs five thousand rupiah. The city is going to add two more lines next year.
options: Bandung is going to build a new airport.
A new bus line has started in Bandung.
The train station in Bandung has a new ticket price.
question.explanation: Kalimat pertama memberi berita utamanya: **A new bus line has started in Bandung today** (Jalur bus baru mulai beroperasi di Bandung hari ini). Bandara dan stasiun adalah tujuan busnya, dan lima ribu rupiah adalah harga tiket bus: itu detail. Tidak ada yang menyebut bandara baru.
displayOptions: Jalur bus baru mulai beroperasi di Bandung.
Stasiun kereta di Bandung punya harga tiket baru.

steps.title: Dengarkan: sebuah podcast
steps.text: Pembukaan sebuah podcast. Tunggu kata-kata yang memberi topik episode **ini**.

question.listen: Hello and welcome to Work Talk, the podcast for young workers in Indonesia. I'm Rina. In this episode, I'm going to talk about working from home. First, I'll explain how to plan your day. Then I'll give you three tips to stop checking your phone all the time.
question.prompt: Dengarkan podcast-nya. Apa topik episode ini?
options: Young workers in Indonesia
Finding your first job
Working from home
question.explanation: **In this episode, I'm going to talk about** working from home (bekerja dari rumah): itulah topiknya. *The podcast for young workers in Indonesia* menjelaskan podcast-nya secara umum, bukan episode ini. Merencanakan hari dan tips soal ponsel adalah poin-poin di dalam topik itu.

steps.title: Catatan, bukan kalimat
steps.text: Keterampilan terakhir: menulis apa yang kamu dengar, dengan cepat.
steps.body: Kamu tidak bisa menulis setiap kata, jadi tulis **kata kunci**: **siapa, apa, kapan** (hari, tanggal, jam), **di mana** (tempat, ruangan) dan **angka**. Tulis angka sebagai digit dan pakai singkatan: *Mon 20, 9:30*. Simbol membantu: **→** = so (jadi), **+** = and (dan). Catatan boleh dalam bahasa Inggris, Indonesia atau campuran. Setelah ada perubahan (*not Monday*, *However*, *Instead*), tulis hanya info yang **baru**. Jebakan: thir**TEEN** vs **THIR**ty; *half past one* = **1.30**, padahal *setengah satu* = 12.30!

pairs.id: siapa, apa, kapan, di mana, angka
hari Selasa, bukan Senin → tulis: Tue

steps.title: Dengarkan dan catat
steps.text: Seorang dosen memberi pengumuman. Bayangkan kamu sedang mencatat: hari, tanggal, jam, ruangan, apa yang dibawa.

question.listen: Good morning, everyone. Before we start, an important change. The test is not on Thursday the fifteenth any more. It's on Friday the sixteenth, at half past two, in room B twelve. Please bring a pen and your student card.
question.prompt: Dengarkan dosennya. Catatan mana yang benar?
options: Test: Thu 15 · 2:30 · room B12 · pen + student card
Test: Fri 16 · 2:30 · room B12 · pen + student card
Test: Fri 16 · 1:30 · room B12 · pen + student card
question.explanation: Kamis tanggal 15 adalah hari yang lama (**not on Thursday… any more** = sudah tidak hari Kamis lagi): tulis yang baru, **Fri 16**. **Half past two** = 2.30 (setengah tiga). 1.30 adalah jebakan bahasa Indonesia: *setengah dua* itu 1.30, tapi *half past two* itu 2.30.
displayOptions: Ujian: Kamis 15 · 14:30 · ruang B12 · pena + kartu mahasiswa
Ujian: Jumat 16 · 14:30 · ruang B12 · pena + kartu mahasiswa
Ujian: Jumat 16 · 13:30 · ruang B12 · pena + kartu mahasiswa

steps.title: Ulasan cepat
steps.text: Balik tiap kartu. Coba ucapkan bahasa Inggrisnya sebelum melihat.

steps.title: Ringkasan
steps.text: Poin utama, signpost, berita, podcast dan catatan dalam satu halaman.

artifact.title: Ringkasan · Menyimak poin utama
artifact.intro: Apa yang kamu dengar, apa artinya, dan apa yang perlu kamu tulis.
rows: The main reason is… / The most important thing is…
info yang baru atau benar datang setelahnya
tulis rencana baru, bukan yang lama
hasilnya atau apa yang harus dilakukan
Here is the news. … has opened / has started
Berikut beritanya. … sudah dibuka / sudah mulai
Today's topic is… / In this episode, …
Topik hari ini… / Di episode ini…
tips: Tanyakan: siapa yang bicara, topiknya apa, pesan utamanya apa? Poin utama sering ada di kalimat-kalimat pertama.
Catatan = kata kunci: siapa, apa, kapan, di mana, angka. Pakai digit, singkatan, → untuk so, + untuk and.
Tunggu sampai kalimatnya selesai: setelah **however**, **instead** atau **not**, info yang lama sudah tidak berlaku.
